name: app-6a9ec9e7a1c0819182f09abd00edd2cc
description: Work on your Episto surveys from ChatGPT: follow fieldwork, read results, build questionnaires and analyse AI Chat interviews.

interface.longDescription:
Episto is a market research platform for running surveys and AI-moderated interviews. This plugin connects ChatGPT to your Episto account so you can analyze survey results and manage your studies in plain language. Every action runs with your own Episto permissions.

With Episto in ChatGPT you can:
- Read survey results: aggregated answers per question, cross-tabulated by segment, and individual responses.
- See where participants screen out or drop out of a questionnaire.
- Follow fieldwork: number of completes against targets and quotas.
- List your surveys and see the questions they contain.
- Build or edit a questionnaire: sections, questions, standard question blocks and recodes.
- Create dashboards and add result cards to them.
- On AI-moderated interview studies, create analysis grids and ask a question answered for every respondent or every population.
- Read and reply to the review comments left on a questionnaire.

You need an existing Episto account to connect.
defaultPrompt: List my Episto surveys and tell me which ones are in fieldwork.
How is fieldwork going on my latest Episto survey? Are any quotas behind?
Show me the results of the first question of my latest Episto survey, split by age group.

positive.description: List the surveys the user can access
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the demo survey "L'assiette des Français 🥖🧀🇫🇷" with its status (complete) and the account it belongs to.

positive.description: Read the structure of a survey
positive.prompt: What questions does the Episto survey "L'assiette des Français" contain?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the questions of the survey (Q1, Q2, ...) with their type and wording.

positive.description: Diagnose the completion funnel of a survey
positive.prompt: Where do participants screen out or drop out in the Episto survey "L'assiette des Français"?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the questionnaire funnel step by step, with the number of participants who screened out or dropped out at each step.

positive.description: Read the aggregated results of a question
positive.prompt: Show me the results of question Q1 of the Episto survey "L'assiette des Français".
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the distribution of answers to Q1 (counts and percentages), matching the Results page of the survey in Episto.

positive.prompt: Create a new draft Episto survey called "ChatGPT test" with one open question asking what people ate for lunch.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft survey with one section and one open question, and returns its token. Nothing is sent to respondents.

negative.description: Unrelated creative request: the plugin must not be called
negative.prompt: Write a short poem about French cheese.

negative.description: General knowledge question unrelated to the user's Episto data: the plugin must not be called
negative.prompt: What is the average sample size for a national survey in France?

negative.description: Survey that does not exist: a clear not-found message and no data from other accounts
negative.prompt: Show me the results of Episto survey abc123.
